name: CreatePortableBackup
transaction_boundary: snapshot/encryption/complete-set construction/self-verification occur outside writer transaction; only a fully verified atomically published SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_SET_V1 is followed by one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork for completed evidence/audit
guards: operator-selected canonical destination directory and safe basename
final destination resolves to one new *.somabackupset directory outside source-control/runtime-owned paths
enough bounded local space for payload plus companions plus verification staging
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay returns recorded complete-set identity only when the final set directory still contains the exact governed members and detached manifest/HMAC/payload digest verify to the recorded PortableBackupSetFingerprintV1; never regenerates or re-reveals recovery secret
receipt_order: initial idempotency check -> snapshot -> encrypt payload into temporary set -> write canonical detached manifest -> write detached HMAC authenticity companion -> verify complete set from disk -> atomic directory publication -> final revalidation -> command_receipt -> completed evidence/audit -> commit
mutations: LLD-01 command receipt and security.portable_backup_exported audit/result evidence only; the portable set is external non-authoritative output and is not inserted into managed_backup_catalog
revision_effects: no application/domain/security entity revision is incremented by portable export; committed replay records no new receipt/audit and increments nothing
post_commit_work: none; the complete portable set was already atomically published and fully verified before the evidence UnitOfWork commits
rules: recovery secret is generated independently and displayed exactly once
payload.somabackup alone is never a successful portable backup
manifest.json and auth.json are mandatory bound companions and must verify before success
no completed evidence before detached-set authenticity, payload cryptography and reconstructed database verification all succeed
